reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (the "EBRD" or the "Bank") invested EUR 12.5 million in the EUR 350 million, 5-year senior unsecured bond (the "Bond") issued by Titan Global Finance Plc (the "Issuer") and guaranteed by Titan SA (the "Company" or the "Client") and listed on Euronext Dublin. The Bond finances General Corporate Purposes and an amount equal to the EBRD use of proceeds will finance decarbonisation capital expenditure in Albania and Greece, aligned with Titan's decarbonisation strategy, including (i) to increase consumption of alternative raw materials and alternative fuels; (ii) to increase manufacturing of cement with lower clinker content; and (iii) in energy efficiency and waste heat recovery.
